result.markdown:
# Sluggish performance on S-SAH-010 due to microwave link degradation

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** transport_degradation at `LNK-SAH-01-B`
- **Confidence:** medium (Major alarm directly evidenced on the link matching KPI onset timing, and changes, maintenance checked and ruled out. External events NOT CHECKED.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-10 20:45 to 2026-09-11 01:11
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-10 20:37
- **Affected:** S-SAH-010, S-SAH-003, S-SAH-005

## Summary

Transport degradation on the shared microwave link LNK-SAH-01-B caused capacity reduction and increased latency across downstream sites.

Users experienced slow data and latency spikes on S-SAH-010 and sibling sites S-SAH-003 and S-SAH-005 for over four hours.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-10 18:17: Minor LINK_DEGRADED raised on LNK-SAH-01-B. [ALM-000222]
- 2026-09-10 18:31: Minor LINK_DEGRADED cleared on LNK-SAH-01-B. [ALM-000222]
- 2026-09-10 20:37: Major LINK_DEGRADED alarm raised on microwave link LNK-SAH-01-B. [ALM-000225]
- 2026-09-10 20:45: Earliest KPI onset and anomaly latency spike detected on S-SAH-010. [T3, ANM-000123]
- 2026-09-11 01:11: Major LINK_DEGRADED alarm cleared on LNK-SAH-01-B. [ALM-000225]

## Evidence

- Latency spikes occurred on three sites in SAH (S-SAH-003, S-SAH-005, S-SAH-010) for 4 hours starting at 20:45. [T1]
- S-SAH-010 depends on microwave link LNK-SAH-01-B, aggregation router AGG-SAH-01, and core upf CORE-UPF-01. [T2]
- A major LINK_DEGRADED alarm was raised on LNK-SAH-01-B at 20:37. [T4, ALM-000225]
- No changes were found on S-SAH-010, S-SAH-003, S-SAH-005, AGG-SAH-01 and its parents between 18:00 and 02:00. [T5]
- No maintenance window was scheduled on LNK-SAH-01-B, AGG-SAH-01 and its parents between 18:00 and 02:00. [T6]

## Hypotheses

1. **transport_degradation** at LNK-SAH-01-B: confirmed. Major alarm on LNK-SAH-01-B matches downstream latency spikes and runbook signature perfectly. [T4, T7, ALM-000225]
2. **bad_change** at S-SAH-010: rejected. No changes were found on affected nodes and their parents during the incident window. [T5]

## Ruled out

- ALM-000222: Minor link degraded alarm cleared quickly at 18:31, well before the 20:45 anomaly onset.

## Recommended actions

- Inspect microwave link LNK-SAH-01-B hardware and fading logs.
- Monitor LNK-SAH-01-B error rates and modulation stability.

## Sources

- `ALM-000222`: minor LINK_DEGRADED on LNK-SAH-01-B, raised 2026-09-10 18:17, cleared 2026-09-10 18:31

- `T5`: get_changes(start=2026-09-10 18:00, end=2026-09-11 02:00, node_ids=['S-SAH-010', 'S-SAH-003', 'S-SAH-005', 'AGG-SAH-01'], include_ancestors=True) -> No changes on S-SAH-010, S-SAH-003, S-SAH-005, AGG-SAH-01 and its parents between 2026-09-10 18:00 and 2026-09-11 02:00.
